name: mail_message
description: JVS type for an enriched Mac Mail message. Inherits sysobject (id: core_id, title/body/description: core_mls, times: core_dates) so title (subject) and body (summary) both get the full enrichment surface — clean, segmented, pos, segmented_ner — populated by the JVS enrichment engine (jvs-enrich step) when it runs. Adds mail-specific fields on top: sender_address, sender_domain, mailbox_url, read/flagged flags. Populate title.mls[0].text with the subject line and body.mls[0].text with the summary preview from the Envelope Index; enrichment then extracts persons, orgs, locations from both.
